sources.locator: "COVID-19 pandemic in South America", revision 1372456988, lead

explanation: The continental article dates the arrival to one case: "The COVID-19 pandemic was confirmed to have reached South America on 26 February 2020 when Brazil confirmed a case in São Paulo." The Brazilian article says where that case had been: "a man from São Paulo who had traveled to Italy tested positive for the virus." The type is `caused`, on the article's own account of the first case. The edge claims nothing about the whole continent. The confidence is `probable` because Wikipedia is the only source.
